name: copilot

argv: Read the task in {prompt_file} and carry it out. End with your final answer.

notes: Programmatic mode takes the prompt as an argument, so the harness passes a prompt file. --silent prints only the agent's response. --allow-all-tools grants every tool without asking: narrow it with --allow-tool / --deny-tool where a node should not run commands. Authentication comes from the CLI sign-in or COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN.
